title: Easier and better ways to stay dapper.
text: I had this subscription for 4 months. I really enjoyed getting them in the mail each month, but it became rather redundant after a few boxes arrived. Very similar items in every box. You’ll probably get socks, a tie, a tie clip or lapel pin and a sample sized miscellaneous product. Great the first couple times around, but feels like a waste of money after an extended period of time.
label: neutral
